PART   IV
ENTITLEMENT OF A VICTIM OF CRIME OR WITNESSES
TO SEEK PROTECTION
27.  Where a victim of crime or witness or any other person
on  behalf  of  a  victim  of  crime  or  witness  has  reasonable
grounds to believe that such victim of crime or witness may
be  subject  to  any  harm,  injury,  intimidation,  reprisal  or
retaliation as a consequence of the circumstances relating to
his being a victim of crime or witness, such victim of crime
or  witness  or  other  person  shall  be  entitled  to  apply  for
protection in terms of the provisions of this Part of this Act.
